Malls in Santiago

Selected shopping centres to help plan your shopping in Santiago, Chile.

  • Cenco Costanera

    Six-level shopping centre with more than 300 stores, a Jumbo supermarket and 12 cinema screens. Sky Costanera operates inside the complex.

  • Parque Arauco

    Las Condes shopping centre with stores, dining, events and parking. Its official offer includes Piso Diseño, Distrito de Lujo, Bazar Gourmet and Boulevard.

  • Cenco Alto las Condes

    Las Condes shopping centre with the Alto Diseño and Mirador spaces. It has access points on Presidente Kennedy Lateral, Padre Hurtado and Gilberto Fuenzalida.

  • Casacostanera

    Vitacura shopping centre with more than 80 stores and a boutique experience covering fashion, beauty, décor, entertainment and dining. It includes an open-air promenade and parking.

  • Mall Sport

    Shopping centre specialising in sports, with aquatic, high mountain, cycling, climbing, ski/snowboard and surf categories. Laguna Mall Sport is part of its official programme.

  • Mallplaza Egaña

    La Reina shopping centre with Cinépolis, dining, entertainment and Click & Collect. Plaza Egaña station connects Lines 3 and 4 and has an access marked Mall.

  • Cenco Florida

    La Florida shopping centre with Mirador Florida, Auto City, a vaccination centre, bicycle services and dining.

  • Mallplaza Vespucio

    La Florida shopping centre with Cinemark, dining, entertainment and Click & Collect.

  • Mallplaza Norte

    Huechuraba shopping centre with Cinemark, dining, entertainment and Click & Collect.

  • Apumanque

    Las Condes shopping centre that officially presents itself as Chile's first mall. Its directory organises fashion, jewellery, health and beauty, home, children's, hobby and dining offers.

  • Cenco Portal La Dehesa

    Lo Barnechea shopping centre with a cinema, play plaza, parking, bicycle parking and nursing room.

  • Mallplaza Oeste

    Cerrillos shopping centre with Cinemark, dining, entertainment and Happyland Park.

  • Arauco Maipú

    Shopping centre with a Maipú identity and an offer of stores, services, cinema and games, presented as a family meeting place.

  • Mallplaza Los Dominicos

    Las Condes shopping centre with Cinépolis, dining and entertainment. Its services include FONASA and AFEX.

  • Vivo Los Trapenses

    Shopping centre with Unimarc, Wi-Fi, free parking, lockers, electric charging and a Pet Friendly policy. Its entertainment includes Chuck E. Cheese's and Coney Jump.

  • Mall Paseo Quilín

    Peñalolén shopping centre with access from Quilín station on Line 4. Its offer includes terraces, Cineplanet, a dining boulevard and a food court.

  • Mallplaza Tobalaba

    Puente Alto shopping centre with Falabella, Pandora and Levi's. Its entertainment offer includes Cinemark, Happyland and Rally Kart.

  • Espacio Urbano Gran Avenida

    San Miguel shopping centre with cinema, food, entertainment, supermarket and services. It has workshops and a free Sala Comunitaria Gran Avenida.

  • Centro Comercial Midmall

    Maipú outlet with cinema screens, restaurants and a gym. Its official offer includes a food court, Family Park, Coney Jump and Rally Kart.

  • Mallplaza Alameda

    Estación Central shopping centre with Ripley, H&M, Tottus and Puma. It also offers Registro Civil, IntegraMédica, Autoplaza, Happyland and Cineplanet.

  • Mall Barrio Independencia

    Independencia shopping centre with cinema, coworking, Fonasa, RedSalud, free modular games and parking. Hospitales station on Line 3 is 800 metres away.

  • Mall Arauco Quilicura

    Quilicura shopping centre presented as a renovated family meeting place, with cinemas, stores and services. It has Cinépolis, bicycle parking and accessible services.

  • Mall Paseo San Bernardo

    San Bernardo shopping centre with access points at Eyzaguirre 650, Urmeneta 661 and San José 672. It includes Cinépolis, Family Park, a gym and a food court.

  • MUT / Mercado Urbano Tobalaba

    Mixed-use project presented as Chile's first urban market, with commercial and cultural exchange and a sustainability focus. It connects directly to Tobalaba station on Lines 1 and 4.
